items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You supposed to recall the Claret wine, Fox? Is that the name?

ctx.x: It's where out in the country. I don't know, there's big trees, picnics. You don't have to worry about carrying no food, because everybody had a basket. And back in those days, you used to drink. Had the very best wine, the Claret wines, Italian Claret wine. You had the best wine and stuff.
You supposed to recall the Claret wine, Fox? Is that the name?

Oh, yeah. Well, everybody would bring their baskets. Uh-huh. Would hide it, by the bandstand. Well, who used to watch for the best basket? We'd steal the best wine out of that basket. About when would you say this was, what you said? Well, this was around 1910. Around 1910. Yeah. And we'd catch the train at 7 o'clock in the morning. And the train, see, the train, back at that time, there wasn't no bridge in New Orleans. See, the train would leave from down the Esplanade Street in the river. See, the train would…
